Register Details:

CONFIG

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:11Reserved--Reserved
10ENABLED_NDRW0x0Repetition enable. 1: the copy is performed NUM_REPETITIONS times, with SRC_STRIDE and DST_STRIDE added to the addresses between rows; set it for every transfer, including a linear copy with NUM_REPETITIONS = 1. 0: the repetition count is forced to zero, so the command completes with an error response, moves no data, and still retires its transfer ID.
9:7DST_MAX_LLENRW0x0Base-2 logarithm of the maximum write burst length in 64-bit beats, applied when DST_REDUCE_LEN is 1. A write burst does not cross a boundary aligned to 2^(DST_MAX_LLEN+3) bytes; 0 gives single-beat bursts. Ignored when DST_REDUCE_LEN is 0.
6:4SRC_MAX_LLENRW0x0Base-2 logarithm of the maximum read burst length in 64-bit beats, applied when SRC_REDUCE_LEN is 1. A read burst does not cross a boundary aligned to 2^(SRC_MAX_LLEN+3) bytes; 0 gives single-beat bursts. Ignored when SRC_REDUCE_LEN is 0.
3DST_REDUCE_LENRW0x0Destination burst-length reduction. 1: write bursts are limited by DST_MAX_LLEN. 0: a write burst is at most 256 beats and does not cross a 2 KiB-aligned boundary.
2SRC_REDUCE_LENRW0x0Source burst-length reduction. 1: read bursts are limited by SRC_MAX_LLEN. 0: a read burst is at most 256 beats and does not cross a 2 KiB-aligned boundary.
1DECOUPLE_RWRW0x0Read/write decoupling. 0: read and write bursts are formed in lockstep, one write burst per read burst. 1: read and write bursts are formed and issued independently; this mode can deadlock.
0DECOUPLE_AWRW0x0Write-address decoupling. 0: the write address of each burst is held until the first read data beat of the matching read burst returns. 1: write addresses are issued without waiting for read data.

STATUS_0

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:10Reserved--Reserved
9:0BUSYR0x0Status for the active stream: bits [7:0] each indicate readiness to accept another command, bit 8 indicates midend activity, and bit 9 is zero. These bits do not report backend busy or prove transfer completion; use DONE for completed transfer IDs. Unused streams read zero.

DST_ADDRESS_LO

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Destination address for DMA to write to, lower 32 bits

DST_ADDRESS_HI

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Destination address for DMA to write to, upper 32 bits. Bits [31:24] (combined address bits [63:56]) are discarded, not checked; program them as zero.

SRC_ADDRESS_LO

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Source address for DMA to read from, lower 32 bits.

SRC_ADDRESS_HI

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Source address for DMA to read from, upper 32 bits. Bits [31:24] (combined address bits [63:56]) are discarded, not checked; program them as zero.

LENGTH_LO

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Number of bytes to move, lower 32 bits.

LENGTH_HI

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Number of bytes to move, upper 32 bits. Bits [31:24] (combined length bits [63:56]) are discarded, not checked; program them as zero.

DST_STRIDE_LO

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Stride amount on destination address side, lower 32 bits

DST_STRIDE_HI

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Stride amount on destination address side, upper 32 bits. Bits [31:24] (combined stride bits [63:56]) are discarded, not checked; program them as zero.

SRC_STRIDE_LO

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Stride amount on source address side, lower 32 bits

SRC_STRIDE_HI

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Stride amount on source address side, upper 32 bits. Bits [31:24] (combined stride bits [63:56]) are discarded, not checked; program them as zero.

NUM_REPETITIONS_LO

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Number of rows to copy, including the first, lower 32 bits. SRC_STRIDE and DST_STRIDE are added to the addresses between rows. Takes effect only when CONFIG.ENABLED_ND is 1.

NUM_REPETITIONS_HI

BitsFieldAccessResetDescription
31:0DATARW0x0Number of rows to copy, upper 32 bits. The DMA uses only the low 32 bits of the row count, so this register is discarded, not checked; program it as zero.
